# Lesson Planet

> > Lesson Planet provides over 2.5 million curated lesson plans, worksheets, and educational resources for K-12 teachers with curriculum management tools.

The platform offers standards-aligned teaching materials (NGSS, CCSS) with features like Collection Builder, Curriculum Manager, and Collection Player to help educators discover, organize, and deliver OER and premium content across all subject areas and grade levels.

## Key Topics

- Lesson Plans
- Teacher Resources
- Curriculum Management
- OER (Open Educational Resources)
- K-12 Education
- Collection Builder
- Curriculum Manager
- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- CCSS (Common Core State Standards)
- Worksheets
- Resource Curation
- Teaching Tools
- Educational Standards
- Collection Player
